question: Which arbitration decisions and organization-contributed precedents may be read by members of which organizations, which offices may add a decision to the shared library or change what an organization contributed, how is a decision marked public or restricted and who reviews it before it is shared, and may an organization withdraw a contribution?
decision: Owner org reads its own rows in full. Another org reads a precedent only if it is marked public or names that org in an explicit grant (as 0030 implements), and always as the anonymized projection: no grievor, no embedding. Only the contributing org's officer or admin may add, change, share or withdraw a contribution; withdrawal removes it from others immediately. Publishing to public needs a second reviewer from the contributing org. The platform-wide arbitration_decisions library holds only published public decisions; writes are platform staff under mandate (see platform staff mandate).
